title: AnitoSetupMigrations
description: Registry of schema version changes. Each entry describes what changed, why, and what Anito should do when it encounters a state file at the previous version.

fromVersion.description: The schema version this migration upgrades from.

toVersion.description: The schema version this migration produces.

reason.description: Why this schema change was made. Required — future engineers and LLMs need this context.

breaking.description: True if this migration removes or renames fields. Breaking migrations cannot be auto-applied.

autoMigratable.description: True if Anito can apply this migration automatically without developer input.

addedSteps.description: Step IDs introduced in this version.

removedSteps.description: Step IDs removed in this version. Removal requires a reason.

instructions.description: Instructions shown to the developer when their state file is behind this version. Written for humans and LLMs alike.
